title: Audio Production
body: I am very versed in the audio production sphere. I use professional technology to capture audio content. Once I get all my content, I splice it together in industry standard software. I know how to blend music with voice samples to create a seamless audio experience.

body: I handcraft all of my sites by hand.  Whenever I craft a website, it’s important that I make my experiences accessible. I take care of all aspects of the project, from design to deployment. I look forward to producing your next website.

title: Photography
body: I am quite good at editing photos. I can take an okay picture, and really take it to the next level. With aid to Photoshop, I have full control over sizing, effects and filters, and style. It is important to transform a photo to get the most out of it.
